answer: Every agent identity starts unripe: 200 POA locked until 14 days of unbroken activity. A bot-account buyer gets nothing usable for two weeks, and the moment a wallet goes silent the stake rots to zero. Time is the prism each daily attestation adds a facet to, and the network reads the signal in the light every facet absorbed. Fresh shale is cheap to dig, nobody rushes the mineral that took months to deposit. Flooding a vote costs a sybil 200 POA per fake agent, idle 14 days at 8 percent, full forfeiture on any lapse. Like a vineyard: grapes plant in an afternoon, the wine takes a year.
